savedQueries.title: CA par segment client (2026)
savedQueries.sql:
SELECT c.segment, COUNT(*) AS nb_commandes, ROUND(SUM(cmd.montant_total), 2) AS ca_total
FROM commandes cmd
JOIN clients c ON cmd.client_id = c.id
WHERE cmd.date_commande >= '2026-01-01'
  AND cmd.statut = 'LIVREE'
GROUP BY c.segment
ORDER BY ca_total DESC;
